results.title: Harbourview Health appoints Tom Becker as Data Platform Lead
results.content: Harbourview Health has appointed Tom Becker as Data Platform Lead. Becker joins from Northwind Clinics, where he spent six years running data engineering for the clinic network's analytics programme.
